attachment_id.description: The attachment's id (`a_…`), from an `@attachment(id="a_…")` mention or an `<attachment id="a_…">` block.

max_chars.description: Characters in the text window: default 20000, at most 100000.

offset.description: First character of the text window (text files and office documents only). Default 0.

session_id.description: The session holding it. Optional: the id alone finds it.

AttachmentKind.description: What `session::read-attachment` makes of a stored file.

oneOf.description: UTF-8 text, returned in character windows.
An office document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV), converted by `document::to-markdown` and returned in character windows.
Anything else: saved in a temporary folder and opened with the agent's own tools.

AttachmentMeta.description: Metadata of one stored attachment. The bytes live in the session's attachment store (`session::get-attachment`), never inline in the transcript: a message references them through a [`ContentBlock::File`] block carrying the same `attachment_id`.

attachment_id.description: Store-generated id (`a_<uuid>`), unique within the session.

mime.description: MIME type, as uploaded (`application/octet-stream` when unknown).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

ReadAttachmentResponse.description: `null` when no session holds the attachment.

how_to_read.description: Without `text`: the exact calls that read or save the file on this engine (or the worker to install) and, for a document, why it has no text. With a document's text: the embedded images it leaves out, if any.

kind.description: From the mime type and the extension; a text file that is not UTF-8 is `binary`.

next_offset.description: The `offset` of the next window; `null` at the end of the text and without `text`.

text.description: The characters `[offset, offset + max_chars)` of a text file or of an office document's markdown; `null` for the other kinds and for a document without text or that could not be converted.

total_chars.description: Characters in the whole text; `null` without `text`.
